missions.name: FloodWatch-1
missions.objective: Image the Indus floodplain for 30 days and downlink at least 20 usable images.
missions.description: In 2022 record monsoon rains flooded a third of Pakistan and Lake Manchar burst its banks. Build a 3U CubeSat that watches the floodplain from orbit.
missions.notes: Budget = 7.5 M USD launch + 220 k USD spacecraft, so the premium HD build only just fits. Mass limit is a game value.

successCriteria.text: Reach orbit and deploy the CubeSat
Keep the satellite alive for 30 days
Stay within the 7.72 M USD budget

missions.rewardCredit: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey.

missions.name: Moonshot
missions.objective: Fly the Saturn V to a 185 km parking orbit with at least 3,100 m/s left in the S-IVB for trans-lunar injection.
missions.description: Recreate the first half of an Apollo launch with the real Saturn V stage data.
missions.notes: 3,100 m/s is a game threshold, tuned after a test flight. The lumped interstage + escape-tower mass drops with the S-II; the 2,000 kg Instrument Unit stays.

successCriteria.text: Keep 3,100 m/s in the S-IVB for TLI

missions.name: Rehbar-I, 1962
missions.objective: Fly a two-stage solid sounding rocket from Sonmiani to about 130 km and release a sodium-vapour cloud.
missions.description: On 7 June 1962 Pakistan launched its first rocket, Rehbar-I, from Sonmiani near Karachi: a two-stage Nike-Cajun flown with NASA support.
missions.storyCard: Rehbar-I lifted off from Sonmiani on 7 June 1962. Its sodium-vapour cloud let scientists on the ground watch winds high in the upper atmosphere.
missions.notes: The Nike-Cajun vehicle is added with this mission (P1).

missions.name: Failure Lab: Apollo 12 lightning
missions.objective: Lightning strikes your Saturn V twice during ascent. Pick the switch that brings the telemetry back.

missions.name: Sandbox
missions.objective: No budget, no limits: build anything and fly it.
